description: The Provincial Base Map Series depicts Alberta municipalities, major roads, railways, hydrography and the Alberta Township System. The reviewed packages cover 40 base-map and thematic variants at 1:750,000, 1:1,000,000 and 1:2,000,000 scales. Source descriptions explicitly identify the smaller-scale maps as generalised versions and the larger-scale maps as enlarged versions of the same base map, with separate overlay themes. These variants form one series. Overlays include administrative districts, planning regions, parks, treaty areas, forest management and hydrologic units. The maps are supplied as PDF; selected hydrologic overlays are described as georeferenced PDFs. Update statements vary between annual and approximately five-year cycles, so no common currentness is inferred. The mapped transport assets establish the infrastructure role; unrelated natural and administrative themes remain contextual. Geographic coverage is within Alberta. Related map components retain their native catalogue identities. The native packages list Open Government Licence - Alberta and unrestricted access, but isopen is false. Actual file access and any cost are unverified. Distribution metadata mainly points to HTML/XML descriptive pages; these are not machine-readable infrastructure geometries. No map, PDF, image, archive or dataset body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are not stated. Two further explicitly described series variants add the 1:750,000 HUC8/HUC10 watershed overlay and the 1:2,000,000 reserve/settlement overlay. Their common base features, scale-generalisation wording and PDF map-sheet form establish companion-series membership. They are not new standalone datasets.
